why_n_equals_1_is_a_screen_not_a_confirm.consequence_at_n_equals_1: a crossover observed between two single-seed policies is NOT distinguishable from that same PPO seed noise. n=1 can find CANDIDATES; it cannot establish complementarity.
why_n_equals_1_is_a_screen_not_a_confirm.therefore: single-seed specialist probes are SCREENS. A crossover they surface is a hypothesis, and the frozen crossover decision rule still governs whether it counts.

interpreting a crossover between two seeds of the SAME training condition as evidence that diversity created specialization -- that is policy variation, not strategic structure
